fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "int", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "bool", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      else
        demand(
            at(ts, 0) == at(ts, 1)
              && (at(ts, 0) /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

    let c = at(matches, 0)

    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["int", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text", "null"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> elem(t, ["bool", "null"]), ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      elif elem(e.op, ["IS NULL", "IS NOT NULL"]) then
        "bool"
      elif e.op == "COALESCE" then
        let concrete = filter(\(t) -> t /= "null", ts)
        let common = if length(concrete) == 0 then "null" else at(concrete, 0)
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == common, concrete), "TYPE_ERROR")
        common
      else
        demand(
            (at(ts, 0) == at(ts, 1) || elem("null", ts))
              && (not(elem("bool", ts)) || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      let vs = map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group)
      if op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "NOT" then
      JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      elif op == "AND" then
        JBool(truth(a) && truth(b))
      elif op == "OR" then
        JBool(truth(a) || truth(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" && length(e.args) == 0 then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(is_null(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "COUNT" then
        JInt(length(vs))
      elif length(vs) == 0 then
        JNull
      elif op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce(e.args, row, group)
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "IS NULL" then
      JBool(is_null(a))
    elif op == "IS NOT NULL" then
      JBool(not(is_null(a)))
    elif op == "NOT" then
      if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        if is_false(a) || is_false(b) then JBool(false) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(true)
      elif op == "OR" then
        if truth(a) || truth(b) then JBool(true) elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JBool(false)
      elif is_null(a) || is_null(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

  order : List((Int, Bool))

        Cons(r, rows)

        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc), rest) =>
      let c = compare_value(at(a, i), at(b, i))
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc then
        -c
      else
        c

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  demand(not(elem(w, ["NULL", "COALESCE"])), "UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

  let sels = selections()

  let (ss, js) = join_sources([source()], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then

  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then

      group_keys()
    else

  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {

    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
